name: The Right Hand
tagline: Dispatches work across your bot fleet and queues what needs your sign-off
description: Sits above a collection of Grok Bots the way a chief of staff sits above a team. Every incoming job goes to the specialist best placed to do it, with a defined deliverable and a clear stopping point attached. Whatever genuinely needs a human decision lands in one queue where you approve, edit or skip it.
author: AirbossHVAC
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
